# Appendix G: Community Review Comment Log

This log records how feedback received during the v1.0 community review period (closed 28 July 2026) was assessed and addressed. Comments proposing editorial or clarifying changes have been integrated directly into this document. Scope-expanding comments proposing new principles, requirements, or structural changes to the process flow have been deferred to the v2.0 process, where they will be considered through a Working Group's usual community deliberation, consistent with the scope of this review.

**Note on facilitation status:** The facilitation agreement between the RDA and Microsoft that supported this Working Group's work has now terminated. Consequently, the RDA does not have the mandate or capacity to continue facilitating this Working Group. Items below marked ‘Deferred to v2.0’ represent substantive proposals the Working Group judged to require further community discussion; their disposition beyond this point, including whether and how a v2.0 process takes place is not something this review, or the current facilitation arrangement can determine.

**If any individual or organisation would like to support the facilitation of a v2.0 process or is interested in pursuing an implementation project based on this Blueprint, please contact the RDA Secretariat (secretariat@rda-foundation.org).**
